en: Black‑and‑white view of a large landscaped central park with tree‑lined alleys, flower beds, and a central obelisk/monument, bordered by a busy boulevard and historic buildings, with wooded hills in the background. The reverse has Romanian text printed 'REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ — BRAȘOV — Parcul prieteniei', a Romanian 40‑bani stamp, postal cancellation, and a handwritten message and address dated 16.VIII.1966.
